title: The Gateway Arch- Stepping into America’s West (1/2)
titleZh: 大拱門──走進美國西部的門戶（1/2）
summaryZh: 介紹聖路易大拱門的外觀、建造過程與它象徵的西部拓荒歷史。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — America's National Parks

sentences.text: In the Midwestern city of St. Louis, Missouri, a huge arch of shiny metal rises to a height of nearly 200 meters.
sentences.zh: 在美國中西部的密蘇里州聖路易市，有一座閃亮的金屬大拱門，高度將近兩百公尺。

sentences.text: The arch stands near the edge of the Mississippi River.
sentences.zh: 這座拱門就矗立在密西西比河畔附近。

sentences.text: This famous landmark is called the Gateway Arch.
sentences.zh: 這個著名地標叫做大拱門（Gateway Arch）。

sentences.text: It is the tallest monument in the United States and the tallest arch in the world.
sentences.zh: 它是美國最高的紀念建築，也是全世界最高的拱門。

sentences.text: It represents the westward expansion of the United States from the Mississippi River to the Pacific Ocean.
sentences.zh: 它象徵美國從密西西比河一路向西擴張到太平洋岸。

sentences.text: American building designer Aero Saarinen, who was born in Finland, designed the arch during a national competition in the late 1940s.
sentences.zh: 在芬蘭出生的美國建築設計師 Aero Saarinen，在一九四〇年代末的一場全國競圖中設計了這座拱門。

sentences.text: However, building did not begin until February of 1963. It was finished in 1965. Later,
sentences.zh: 不過一直到一九六三年二月才動工，一九六五年完工。後來，

sentences.text: a transportation system was added to permit people to visit an observation area inside the top of the arch.
sentences.zh: 又加裝了運輸設施，讓民眾可以上到拱門頂端的觀景區參觀。

sentences.text: Saarinen designed the arch to withstand strong winds and earthquakes.
sentences.zh: Saarinen 在設計時就考慮到要能承受強風和地震。

sentences.text: The width of the arch at its bottom is equal to its height of 192 meters.
sentences.zh: 拱門底部的寬度和它一百九十二公尺的高度一樣。

sentences.text: Below ground underneath the arch, the Museum at the Gateway Arch has information about the history of St. Louis and how people settled and lived in the American West.
sentences.zh: 在拱門下方的地下空間，大拱門博物館展出聖路易的歷史，以及人們當年如何在美國西部落腳生活。

sentences.text: St. Louis was an important starting point for hundreds of thousands of Americans who traveled west during the 1800
sentences.zh: 聖路易是數十萬名美國人西行的重要起點，時間就在一八〇〇

sentences.text: s. The exploration and settling of the American West are an important part of the country's history and culture.
sentences.zh: 年代。探索與開拓美國西部，是這個國家歷史和文化很重要的一部分。

sentences.text: When visitors see the huge arch, they can imagine passing under it to travel to a new place and begin a new part of their lives.
sentences.zh: 遊客看到這座巨大的拱門時，可以想像自己從底下穿過，前往一個新的地方，展開人生的新篇章。

sentences.text: The Gateway Arch is a U.S. national park.
sentences.zh: 大拱門是美國的一座國家公園。
